facts.fact: The South African Bureau of Standards published draft AI standards, technical specifications and technical reports for public comment by 10 November 2026, by email on a commenting template, according to a Werksmans explainer carried by Polity.

facts.fact: The South African Bureau of Standards invited organisations that develop or use AI and other interested parties to comment on its draft AI standards by 10 November 2026.
